title: WHEN DECISIONS WEIGH HEAVY
GOD WILL GUIDE YOUR STEPS
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer

scenes.a: Decisions wait for you this morning.
You don't have to map out every single step alone before the sun climbs the sky.
Rest your mind in the timeless promise of God:
'Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.'
Lord, before this day pulls us in every direction, we turn to your wisdom.
Steer our thoughts through every choice today, and lift the heavy pressure to figure it all out.
Hold us steady by your hand, trusting that your gentle counsel leads us straight into your glory.
Amen. Rest in peace, where decisions wait for you this morning.
